notes: State expectations come from games/number-vault/tests/model.py (upstream rules 2.1.0). The only emulator-derived input is origin, upstream's entropy(): each stage start samples the title-song position, logged at 0x4720 (count, values) and fed to the model in order; every other byte is the model's prediction. Each vault is cracked with the model's consistent-guess solver (at most six tries); synthetic-all-vaults opens all ten. synthetic-title and synthetic-first-clear require a PCM peak of 21000.
